dedupe_keys.name: gisfire historical qgis wildfire spread plugin

description: The historical GisFIRE repository contains Jaume Figueras's QGIS plugin for wildfire-spread simulation and fire-management experiments. Its documentation describes a Python port of FARSITE propagation models and an interface for testing other spread algorithms. Inputs are QGIS geographic layers, project settings and ignition points; outputs are simulated spread represented within the GIS project. Settings are stored in QGIS project variables and a companion GeoPackage, with coverage and resolution determined by the selected map layers. Code is free under GPL-3.0 and the public wiki explains the project structure. A limitation is incomplete installation guidance and no tests in the README; this is historical research software, not evidence of a maintained operational fire service. It can support exploratory infrastructure wildfire-exposure simulations. The current GisFIRE applications (platform-gisfire) provide a different, developing data and analysis suite. No geographic layers, propagation-model archive or plugin installer was downloaded.
name: GisFIRE historical QGIS wildfire-spread plugin
